labels.free_move: the mover may play on any open board
labels.target_board: board the mover is sent to (0-8), 9 = free
labels.count_margin: boards won by the mover minus boards won by the opponent
labels.count_sign: sign of count_margin: behind / equal / ahead
labels.boards_full: boards closed as full without a winner
labels.threats_for: macro lines with two mover boards and the third open
labels.threats_against: macro lines with two opponent boards and the third open
labels.dead_count: open boards that neither side can still win
labels.local_win_now: the mover can win a board with this move
labels.local_threat_against: the opponent has a two-in-a-line with the third cell empty in some open board
labels.macro_win_now: the mover can win the game with this move
labels.dead_0: board 0 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_1: board 1 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_2: board 2 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_3: board 3 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_4: board 4 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_5: board 5 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_6: board 6 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_7: board 7 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.dead_8: board 8 is open but unwinnable by either side
labels.final_own_0: board 0 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_1: board 1 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_2: board 2 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_3: board 3 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_4: board 4 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_5: board 5 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_6: board 6 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_7: board 7 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.final_own_8: board 8 at the end of the game: self / neither / opponent
labels.z: final result for the mover: loss / draw / win
labels.best_move_now: the source net's 256-sim (or exact) best move
labels.best_move_ply2: the move two plies down the source net's principal variation (exact where solved)
labels.exact_value: exact value for the mover (loss / draw / win) where solved
